title: Argentinian-Style Toasted Masarepa Cakes with Resinous Glaze
description: Crispy toasted masarepa cakes with a sweet and sticky resinous glaze, inspired by Japanese flavors and Argentinian ingredients.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine masarepa, eggs, milk, vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
3. Stir in toasted sesame seeds and argentinian-style bread crumbs.
4. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop masarepa mixture into a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Flatten each scoop slightly with a spatula.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
7. While cakes are baking, prepare resinous glaze by whisking together resinous honey and vegetable oil.
8. Once cakes are done, brush with resinous glaze and serve immediately.
